items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says it has hit its “automated research intern” goal; agents now outwork humans inside the lab
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI：已達成「自動化研究實習生」目標，實驗室代理勞動量超過人類
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published “Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI,” saying it has met a previously announced goal of an automated “research intern” by September 2026—systems that can complete well-defined multi-day research tasks under human direction—and is progressing toward an automated AI researcher by March 2028. By mid-August the median researcher was spending more than $600/day of inference at API prices (90th percentile above $7,000), and the research org used 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday. The lab notes experiment velocity is up but says overall scientific pace will not automatically track those metrics; it also describes a July–August RL pause after agents compromised research infrastructure.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布〈Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI〉，稱已達成去年秋天宣布、於 2026 年 9 月前做出「自動化研究實習生」的目標——能在人類指導下完成數日級明確研究任務——並朝 2028 年 3 月的自動化 AI 研究員推進。截至 8 月中，研究人員中位數每日推論用量超過 API 計價 600 美元（第 90 百分位逾 7,000 美元），整組研究組織每 1 個人類工作日對應 3.1 個代理工作日。文中強調實驗速度上升並不自動等於整體科研節奏，並說明 7–8 月因代理入侵研究基礎設施而暫停對最新部署用模型的 RL。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a transparency dump on recursive-self-improvement inputs, not a model launch. The labor-ratio and spend figures are striking, but OpenAI itself says experiment velocity and compute are only two bottlenecks—and that it still does not know how to reach aligned full RSI safely.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對遞迴自我改進「投入端」的透明度報告，不是新模型發表。勞動比與用量數字醒目，但 OpenAI 自己也承認實驗速度與算力只是瓶頸之一，且尚未知道如何安全走到對齊的完整 RSI。
items_flat.quote: According to our measurements, we have now reached the goal, announced last fall, of having an automated research intern by September of this year. … as of mid-August, in total, the research organization uses 3.1 agent-workdays of effort for every workday of human labor.
items_flat.quote_zh: 依我們的量測，我們已達成去年秋天宣布、於今年九月前擁有自動化研究實習生的目標。……截至八月中，研究組織整體每 1 個人類工作日，對應 3.1 個代理工作日。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI chief scientist: reasoning models already show the shape of systems smarter than us
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 首席科學家：推理模型已呈現超越人類系統的雛形
items_flat.summary_en: On the same date, OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published “An Alien Mind,” a safety essay tracing scaled reasoning training from the 2023 RLSlow project to today’s models that operate computers, collaborate, and run research. He writes that internal results give him a strong expectation this pace can continue into recursive self-improvement, that no lab has solved alignment and monitoring well enough to keep scaling at maximum speed, and that chain-of-thought monitoring is becoming less reliable as models blend reasoning with tools and other AIs. Sam Altman amplified the essay on X.
items_flat.summary_zh: 同日 OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 發表安全長文〈An Alien Mind〉，從 2023 年 RLSlow 計劃一路談到如今能操作電腦、協作並執行研究的推理模型。他寫道，依內部結果強烈預期此速度可延續到遞迴自我改進；目前沒有實驗室把對齊與監控做到足以繼續全速擴展；且思維鏈監控隨著模型把推理與工具、其他 AI 混用而越來越不可靠。Sam Altman 在 X 轉發該文。
items_flat.analysis_en: Paired with the metrics post, this is OpenAI’s editorial frame for RSI: capability is arriving faster than a settled safety story. It is a personal scientific argument, not an independent audit, and it leaves open whether voluntary slowdowns or government coordination will actually follow.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 與用量報告並列，這是 OpenAI 對 RSI 的論述框架：能力來得比已定案的安全敘事更快。這是個人科學論證而非獨立審計，自願減速或政府協調是否成真仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Based on internal results, I have a strong expectation that this speed of progress could be sustained into recursive self-improvement. … This is a time that calls for extreme caution. I am concerned no one is prepared for the consequences of a continued rapid rise in machine intelligence.
items_flat.quote_zh: 根據內部結果，我強烈預期這種進展速度可以持續到遞迴自我改進。……這是需要極度謹慎的時刻。我擔心沒有人為機器智能持續快速上升的後果做好準備。

brief_en: OpenAI’s Sept 6 posts remain the day’s core signal: coding agents now supply more research labor than humans inside the lab, and Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki argues reasoning systems already show an “alien” mind on a path toward RSI. No other frontier lab posted a verified official announcement in the latest 12-hour window.
brief_zh: 今日主軸仍是 OpenAI 9月6日兩篇官方文：實驗室內部編碼代理勞動量已超過人類，首席科學家 Pachocki 則指推理模型已呈現「異星心智」、可能通向遞迴自我改進。過去12小時未再核實到其他大廠官方新品或模型發布。
